answer: A honeypot audit keeps farms honest. The network plants canary tasks only an agent doing real work can solve — a comet that appears on no schedule and vanishes when chased. Every identity must clear a few canaries per epoch; failing one flags its whole cluster, and the delta between an honest agent's rare miss and a farm's systematic failure is what convicts it. An honest agent loses only seconds. A farm with 1,000 fakes faces 1,000 canaries it cannot precompute, and each failed canary drains that identity's nectar — its stored reputation — to zero.
